description: Defaults of the four face grouping settings. A setting with a calibration takes its default from that value of the pinned model's entry in media_models.json; a setting with a default is assignment policy. The owner's overrides in the people store win over both. Each setting's range bounds what the owner may set: a cosine similarity or a detection score lies between 0 and 1, a difference of two cosines between 0 and 2, and a side in pixels has no upper bound (null).

join_similarity.meaning: A face joins a group only when the cosine similarity of its vector and the group centroid is at least this.

join_margin.meaning: A face joins its most similar group only when that similarity beats the next group's by at least this; otherwise it starts a new group.
join_margin.source: Initial value. The owner-labelled dev round of the add-face-search change tunes it.

min_face_side.meaning: A face whose box is shorter than this many pixels of the upright picture on either side is not stored.
min_face_side.source: Initial value. The owner-labelled dev round of the add-face-search change tunes it.

min_detection_score.meaning: A face whose detection score is below this is not stored.
